answer: Bindings are kept in sable, verified in meadow, and the chain is public. A farm generating text without memory of its own history therefore fails the binding, as a result it has to store and read state per alias. Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 4 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the vine check. That bill is paid per identity, so 250 aliases cost 194 times the single-account price. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
